terminals.summary: Perspective metric depth and current/past raw LiDAR both recovered 0/9 dropout windows because the frozen matcher had no admissible closing signal; this is not a metric-depth or LiDAR negative.

forbidden_repeats: depth-backbone swap on the consumed cohort

terminals.summary: Causal raw-LiDAR occupancy flow recovered 9/9 induced windows and 3/3 critical events, proving an independent spatiotemporal signal exists, but false segments rose 12 to 20 and one-to-one event F1 remained 22.22%.
terminals.successor_requires: A different motion information source or a separately frozen fresh protocol.
forbidden_repeats: attribution/tube/lifecycle tuning on the opened cohort

terminals.summary: Causal native-box point velocity suppressed 8/9 M0 diagnostic pseudo-motion entries but recovered only 6/9 dropout trials, created five new motion-source-induced false segments, and reduced event F1 from 22.22% to 16.00% under the frozen hard point/cell downstream.
terminals.successor_requires: A newly authorized representation-level question and fresh protocol; changing the scene-flow estimator is not eligible under the consumed frozen downstream.
forbidden_repeats: TeFlow or DeltaFlow on the consumed protocol
route-conditioned forecasting on the consumed cohort

terminals.summary: On consumed video17, set-valued belief preserved 100% navigation precision and increased coverage from 73.45% to 81.42%; exact-instance identity was not evaluable because each public goal mapped to multiple physical IDs without a public instance reference.
terminals.successor_requires: A legal public exact-instance authority source rather than matcher tuning.
forbidden_repeats: treating set-valued navigation as exact-instance success

terminals.summary: On fresh source-disjoint video18, legal public instance binding plus temporal belief achieved 100% precision, 91.67% coverage, zero wrong-instance frames/switches, and 6/6 gap reacquisition/end-to-end episodes.
terminals.successor_requires: A new claim layer and separately authorized evidence; the replay result itself cannot establish active observation, arrival, product, user, or safety effects.
forbidden_repeats: using evaluator physical IDs at inference
promoting replay evidence to product or safety

terminals.summary: On one SceneFun3D Development scene, task-relational selection over evaluator-provided unlabeled functional-part proposals improved legal commits from 4/6 to 6/6, mean target-set recall from 50% to 100%, and wrong parts from 2 to 0 while preserving the parent binding.
terminals.successor_requires: A task-conditioned multi-view RGB/RGB-D functional-part proposer behind the frozen parent-binding interface on separately authorized evidence.
forbidden_repeats: using parent-box center as a functional handoff
claiming GT functional proposals as a deployable detector
promoting part selection to reachability, arrival, completion, product, user, or safety evidence

terminals.summary: On one opened SceneFun3D Development scene, truth-blind task-grounded RGB-D proposals plus multi-view consensus raised proposal recall from 8/10 to 10/10, legal task commits from 3/6 to 4/6, mean target-set recall from 50% to 83.33%, and reduced wrong parts from 8 to 2 versus the single-view arm.
terminals.successor_requires: A genuinely new candidate-integrity or action-geometry source on separately versioned evidence; the remaining two in-parent false clusters cannot be rescued by tuning the opened cohort.
forbidden_repeats: detector or prompt threshold sweeps on visit 420683
DBSCAN, seed, or fusion sweeps on the opened cohort
reopening SC9, SC9T, or SC10 with another generic handle detector
promoting privileged parent RGB-D evidence to phone, open-world, arrival, completion, product, user, or safety claims
